Sylas

the Unshackled
Mid laneJungle laneTop laneSupport lane

Top Sylas is a sustain brawler who uses Kingslayer heals and Petricite Burst to out-trade other melee champions, then joins fights with Teleport and a stolen ultimate. He beats tanks who rely on their ultimates and struggles against hard-hitting bruisers who can out-damage his healing.

When to pick Sylas

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Not ideal. Strong early bruisers like Darius and Riven beat him, so pick him after seeing the enemy top.

Pick into

  • Tanks with big ultimates to steal, like Malphite and Cho'Gath
  • Ranged top laners who can't handle his all-in, like Gnar
  • Teams where Teleport plus a stolen ultimate can decide fights

Avoid into

  • Strong early bruisers like Darius, Riven and Renekton
  • Teams with lots of anti-heal
  • Lanes where you'll be ganked a lot without vision

Great teammates

Jarvan IVJarvan IV ganks top well and his engage sets up Sylas's combo.
OriannaHer ball on Sylas makes his dives even stronger.
LeonaA crowd-control support who sets up fights when Sylas teleports in.

Your team needs: Pick top Sylas when your team has another frontline and you can use Teleport to join fights.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Kingslayer heals let you trade back hard in long melee fights
  • Tanks with big ultimates (like Malphite) give you a great steal
  • Teleport plus Hijack gives a strong late entry into fights
  • Petricite Burst clears waves quickly for split-pushing

Weaknesses

  • Strong early bruisers like Darius out-trade you before you have items
  • Short range on a long lane makes you easy to gank
  • Anti-heal cuts down your main way to win trades
  • Needs Hextech Rocketbelt and Riftmaker to fight properly

Power spikes

  • Level 3: full combo; you can win short trades against most tanks
  • Level 6: Hijack; tank ultimates give you a strong engage
  • First item (Hextech Rocketbelt): extra dash and burst
  • Two items (Riftmaker): you start winning long fights against bruisers
  • Levels 18-20: the top role quest raises your level cap to 20

Top tips

  • Play safe against strong early bruisers and win the game later
  • Tanks with big ultimates are your favorite targets to steal from
  • Save Kingslayer for when you're low in long trades
  • Teleport into fights before they start, not after they're lost
  • Use Chain Lash to farm safely under tower
  • Ward the river; top lane is long and you have short range
  • Buy Mercury's Treads against heavy crowd control or AD bruisers
